meta.title: Rafshan Ekhowan — Systems & Photography
meta.description: Rafshan Ekhowan — IPTSP, Network & Systems Engineer, and photographer across street, landscape, product and abstract work.

hero.subtitle: I'm Rafshan — a Network & Systems Executive and photographer. Same instinct either way: read the structure before everyone else sees it.

profile.sectionNote: Executive, Network & System Solution at BRACNet. B.Sc. in Information & Communication Engineering.
profile.lead: Network & System Administration professional managing enterprise network and server infrastructure, Linux systems, virtualization, and IPTSP operations.
paragraphs: Experienced in Proxmox virtualization, network and server monitoring, infrastructure troubleshooting, security, backup, and resource optimization — with a strong record of maintaining high availability across production environments.

Proven ability to identify and resolve technical issues, improve operational reliability, and support secure, efficient IT infrastructure — the same eye for what's about to break (or what's about to happen) that shows up in the photography.

education.desc: Studied networking, systems, and communication engineering.

experience.sectionNote: Roles spanning from IPTSP intern to Executive, plus a networking attachment at Atova Technology.
